issue.title: artifacts Beads stranded PNG snapshot fails identically on master
issue.description:
## CI failure

- Node: tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_beads_stranded.py::test_artifacts_beads_stranded_png_snapshot
- SHA: 7b1b43755821fb4b6fe9ab8f51d09fcff0e46879

Full CI runs [40108758095](https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/40108758095) and [40109539212](https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/40109539212) both fail this strict image check on the same SHA. Each reports artifacts_beads_stranded_120x40: updated with exactly 6793/1520532 changed pixels against tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/artifacts_beads_stranded_120x40.png. The repeated same-SHA mismatch is a confirmed failure, not an intermittent result. Inspect the captured diff and fixture, decide whether rendering or the expected image is wrong, and make an intentional correction after semantic review. Do not relax pixel checks, retry the assertion, or regenerate blindly.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Full CI runs 40108758095 and 40109539212 fail on the identical SHA with the same expected image and identical 6793/1520532 changed-pixel count.

issue.creation_reason: Two Full CI runs on the same master SHA produce the same strict PNG failure. This needs a focused cause review and an intentional correction before the release gate can pass.
